$description: Tattva design tokens in the DTCG format (2025.10). Colors are in separate light and dark groups. Aliases to raw palette values are resolved to final colors. Dark inherits any light value it does not override.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells and the area behind a card.

surface-raised.$description: Menus and pop-ups that float above the page.

surface-hover.$description: A row when the pointer is over it.

lines.$description: Edges and the outline that shows where you are.

border.$description: Thin borders around cards and fields.

border-strong.$description: Borders that need more weight, such as a focused field.

focus-ring.$description: The outline around whatever the keyboard is on.

text.$description: Three weights of text. Contrast is measured against the page.

actions.$description: Dark ink is the main action. Lime is only ever a fill, never text.

fg-on-accent.$description: Text on the main action color.

accent-hover.$description: The main button when the pointer is over it.

lime.$description: The AI mark and one positive highlight.

lime-hover.$description: Lime when the pointer is over it.

lime-soft.$description: A pale lime wash behind small markers.

status.$description: Success, error and information. Each ships with an icon and a word, never color alone.

on-danger.$description: Text on a solid danger button.

attention.$description: Amber means one thing: a person has to act. Nothing else uses it.
The dot and border that call for a person.

attention-soft.$description: Background of a request that needs a person.

warning.$description: Same as attention: a person has to act.

direction.$description: Up and down for prices, profit and loss, and any number that moves. Not the same as success and error. Always shown with an arrow or a sign. For readers who cannot tell green from red, set data-direction=\

up.$description: A value went up or is a gain.

up-soft.$description: Background for an up value, such as a gain row.

down.$description: A value went down or is a loss.

reserved.$description: Two reserved roles. Unsure is a calm neutral for \

unsure.$description: Not fully sure, or partly done.

celebrate.$description: A goal fully reached. One place per product.

charts.$description: Checked so people with color-blindness can tell them apart. Use them in this order.

chart-seq-1.$description: Low to high amounts, step 1 of 5.

chart-seq-2.$description: Low to high amounts, step 2 of 5.

chart-seq-3.$description: Low to high amounts, step 3 of 5.

chart-seq-4.$description: Low to high amounts, step 4 of 5.

chart-seq-5.$description: Low to high amounts, step 5 of 5.
